name: Sijia Liu
title: Red Cedar Distinguished Associate Professor
fitReason: Pion (May 2026) studies optimizer design for vision-language-action adaptation and tests pi0.5 on physical manipulation tasks. This is a concrete robot-foundation-model connection within a broader optimization and trustworthy-AI lab, rather than a general robotics keyword.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full primary paper names a Franka Research 3 in a DROID-style setup with third-person and wrist cameras. pi0.5 is trained from 200 teleoperated trajectories for three grasp-and-place tasks, then evaluated over 30 randomized trials per task/optimizer. The work is a Cisco/MSU/Minnesota collaboration; the inspected evidence does not establish that this arm is available in the MSU lab, so physical evidence is capped at 20.

shortVisit.summary: The live faculty homepage explicitly invites internship, externship and visiting-student inquiries by email with a resume and transcripts. The lab homepage repeats those categories. Its separate vacancies page discusses PhD positions, so that page supplies no additional summer evidence. Duration, external-master’s details and summer 2027 availability remain unspecified.

unknowns: Use Associate Professor as the academic rank from the current personal profile and promotion history. The college directory’s Red Cedar Distinguished Professor label is an honor and is not used to infer promotion to full professor.

Pion is a preprint with a small three-task physical evaluation. LIBERO/Plus success percentages and LLM mathematical-reasoning results are separate simulation/software experiments, not physical robot outcomes.

The physical trial comparison holds the dataset and training-step budget fixed. It does not establish universal optimizer superiority or general robot reliability. Current MSU hardware access needs confirmation.

The existing MSU policy audit supports overseas-enrolled graduate Student Interns and personal funding in principle, with a minimum eight-week application lead time rather than an eight-week minimum stay. It remains subject to faculty/department approval; the July 1, 2027 support threshold increases and insurance details require confirmation.

Summer 2027 acceptance, mentor capacity, exact dates, funding, visitor appointment, and applicable university/immigration approvals remain unconfirmed. Self-funding alone does not establish eligibility.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
